name: application-quota-warning-banner
title: Quota Warning Banner
description: Inline alert combining a threshold-crossing message, an embedded usage bar, and an upgrade call to action, for surfacing approaching or exceeded plan limits inline within page content.
useWhen: A user is approaching or has exceeded a metered limit (storage, API requests, seats) and needs both the numeric context and an immediate upgrade path.
The warning should live inline within the page content the user is already looking at, rather than as a full-width top bar or a separate settings card.
avoidWhen: The message applies site-wide regardless of context — use an announcement banner instead.
You only need a standalone usage summary without an alert framing — use a usage meter card instead.
The limit hasn't been approached yet — don't show a warning for healthy usage levels.
responsiveBehavior: The banner is a single-column flex stack with the usage bar spanning the full available width; the max-w-lg container in the examples can be removed to fill any parent width.
accessibility: Uses role="alert" so the warning is announced immediately, since a crossed quota threshold requires timely user awareness.

The usage bar carries role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/min/max and an aria-label describing what's being measured, so the numeric context is available to screen readers, not just the visual fill.
Color alone doesn't convey severity — the heading text and description explicitly state whether the limit is approaching or exceeded.

variants.title: Approaching limit
variants.description: Amber warning banner for a storage quota nearing its limit, with an inline usage bar and an upgrade CTA
accessibility: role="alert" plus a labeled progressbar communicate both the message and the exact usage figures.

variants.title: Approaching limit (Dark)
variants.description: Amber warning banner for a storage quota nearing its limit, with an inline usage bar and an upgrade CTA
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Limit exceeded
variants.description: Red critical banner for an API request quota that has been fully exhausted, with a full usage bar and both upgrade and view-usage actions
accessibility: role="alert" ensures the exhausted-quota state, which blocks further usage, is announced without user action.

variants.title: Limit exceeded (Dark)
variants.description: Red critical banner for an API request quota that has been fully exhausted, with a full usage bar and both upgrade and view-usage actions
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces, including button states.
